categories.main_business_segments: Jinsanjiang (Zhaoqing) Silicon Material Company Limited primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of precipitated silica (silicon dioxide). Its main product applications include toothpaste abrasives, food and pharmaceutical anti-caking agents, high-end industrial uses such as PE battery separators, silicone rubber reinforcement, and plastic film anti-blocking agents. The company has expanded its product portfolio to serve multiple downstream industries including oral care, food and pharmaceuticals, batteries, silicone rubber, and plastic films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced precipitated silica manufacturing technology with fully automated and intelligent production lines controlled by Distributed Control Systems (DCS) and SAP for production planning. It has proprietary technologies for producing functional silica variants such as anti-sensitivity and high-dispersion silica for toothpaste. The production process emphasizes precise control of reaction parameters, energy efficiency through heat recovery and solar power, and high product quality with narrow particle size distribution. The company holds over 130 patents, including numerous invention patents related to toothpaste silica and industrial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are manufacturers in the oral care industry, especially toothpaste producers, which account for over 90% of revenue. Other key markets include food and pharmaceutical companies requiring anti-caking agents, battery manufacturers (notably lead-acid battery separators), silicone rubber producers, and plastic film manufacturers. The company serves both domestic Chinese customers and international clients, with overseas sales accounting for over 25% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Zhaoqing High-Tech Zone, Guangdong Province, China, with subsidiaries and operations extending to Hong Kong, the United States, Poland, and Mexico. It focuses on the Greater China region as its base while actively expanding into Asia-Pacific, North America, Latin America, and Europe. The company is building a global supply chain and sales network to support its international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinsanjiang operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of precipitated silica materials. It procures raw materials such as sodium silicate and sulfuric acid, processes them into specialized silica products, and sells directly to downstream manufacturers in various industries. The company maintains an independent production, procurement, and sales system without reliance on controlling shareholders for assets or operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a focus on high-end customized silica products and expanding into new application fields. It employs three R&D modes: demand-driven, market-leading innovation, and collaborative development with universities and research institutes. Key R&D projects include low surface area silica for oral care, silica for film anti-blocking agents, low oil absorption and low abrasion silica for toothpaste, and high-performance silica for silicone rubber. The company invests heavily in digitalization and intelligent manufacturing systems such as MES and PLM to enhance R&D and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precipitated silica products to industrial customers, especially toothpaste manufacturers. The company uses a direct sales model supported by marketing and industry exhibitions. Sales are predominantly product-based with pricing influenced by product specifications and application requirements. The company also earns minor income from auxiliary materials and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinsanjiang is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the precipitated silica industry in China, with advanced production capabilities and a strong patent portfolio. It competes with over 50 domestic silica producers, many of which are smaller and less technologically advanced. The company leverages its R&D strength, product quality, and customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge, especially in high-end and functional silica segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 385.5 million, a 31% increase from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 53.4 million, up 52.5%. Total assets reached about RMB 731 million, with steady growth in cash flow from operations. The company maintains a healthy gross margin around 34.5% and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D. It has a registered capital of RMB 231 million and employs over 370 staff, including a significant R&D team.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinsanjiang differentiates itself through high-purity, stable-quality precipitated silica products tailored for specific applications such as toothpaste abrasives with adjustable abrasiveness and compatibility with fluoride. Its functional silica products, including anti-sensitivity and high-dispersion variants, provide unique benefits to customers. The company’s advanced automated production, strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and commitment to sustainable and green manufacturing practices create significant customer value and competitive barriers.
